期刊 / Journal：medrxiv　日期 / Date：日期待核对

局限 / Limitations

英文原文证据 / Original Evidence

Transformer-based foundation models have shown strong potential for modeling longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs), yet existing models focus primarily on risk prediction rather than treatment effect estimation, which limits evidence generation.

Here, we introduce the ITE-Transformer, a transformer-based framework that combines self-supervised representation learning from longitudinal patient trajectories with doubly robust causal machine learning for predicting individualized treatment effects (ITEs).

As a result, our ITE-Transformer allows to study counterfactual questions of how an individual patient's outcome may differ under alternative treatment strategies.

英文原文证据 / Original Evidence

Diabetic kidney disease is the leading cause of kidney failure worldwide, yet the molecular events underlying disease initiation and progression remain unclear.

We measured 5,420 circulating proteins in 830 adults with type 1 diabetes and examined their longitudinal associations with onset and progression of kidney disease over 10 years of follow-up.

We identified 130 proteins associated with at least one outcome independent of established clinical risk factors, of which 59 replicated in an independent cohort.

英文原文证据 / Original Evidence

Clinical interventions for cancer treatment toxicities can reduce morbidity, mortality, and healthcare cost, if high risk patients can be identified.

We developed SPARC, a transformer-based foundation model, using real-world, longitudinal, routinely collected health measurements, to predict adverse event risk.

Pre-training and fine-tuning SPARC on 101,920,379 measurements from 224,047 patients with cancer led to state-of-the-art performance at predicting cancer-related adverse events on (i) held-out data from the development cohort, (ii) a prospective validation cohort from the same center (Npatients=23,126), (iii) multiple publicly available external datasets (Npatients=26,012), and (iv) external, multi-hospital cohorts (Npatients=562,620, 206,840).

英文原文证据 / Original Evidence

Background: Conventional chemotherapies remain the core therapeutic backbone of cancer treatment, yet the rapid emergence of chemoresistance often compromises their clinical efficacy.

Although large-scale functional genomics has transformed precision oncology, existing reference maps rely predominantly on loss-of-function paradigms and lack systematic data on gain-of-function (GOF) events that commonly drive clinical resistance.

Methods: To address this gap, we engineered a site-specific Bxb1 integrase landing-pad system in HeLa cells, enabling single-copy integration of a human proteome-wide library [18,388 open reading frames (ORFs)] at the AAVS1 locus under a uniform EF1 promoter.

英文原文证据 / Original Evidence

Background: The landmark genome-wide association meta-analysis of Alzheimer's disease (AD) and AD-by-proxy across N = 2,815,127 individuals (Uffelmann et al., Nature, 2026) expanded the known susceptibility landscape to 127 independent genomic risk loci (160 association signals) and established an autosomal common-variant SNP heritability of h2_SNP = 16.0% on the liability scale.

Translating these 127 static statistical signals into pathway-stratified clinical trials requires resolving three quantitative gaps: how the non-APOE polygenic architecture partitions across distinct cellular programs, which effector genes operate via cortical parenchymal versus peripheral myeloid gene expression, and which targets possess nanomolar human bioactivity suitable for genetically stratified trials.

Methods: Operating entirely on individual-genotype-free summary statistics structured along a previously established tridimensional diagnostic framework (Axis 1: Etiology and Genetic Architecture; Axis 2: Molecular Pathophysiology and Biomarker Programs; Axis 3: Neuroanatomical-Cognitive Topography; Menendez-Gonzalez, Alzheimers Dement, 2025), we ingested the complete NHGRI-EBI GWAS Catalog build GCST90695466 (8,159,496 autosomal and 160,704 X-chromosome variants).

英文原文证据 / Original Evidence

Cell mobility is critical for homeostatic processes such as wound repair and diseases like cancer metastasis.

While the advent of migrastatic and antimetastatic therapies has promise, the identification and translation of pathways important for migratory plasticity into druggable targets approved in clinical trials are considerably lacking.

To better understand why, we developed an unbiased high-throughput wound-healing/invasion assay to screen for the migratory potential of >60 non-malignant and malignant cell lines derived from the pancreas, colon, skin, breast, prostate, and lung.

英文原文证据 / Original Evidence

Genomic variation shapes phenotypic diversity, yet how genetic variation contributes to transcript isoform diversity remains poorly understood at the population scale.

Here, we integrated transcriptomic data from 240 lettuce accessions with a lettuce pangenome to construct a comprehensive pan isoform atlas comprising 531,657 isoforms from 49,729 transcribed loci.

Isoform presence absence variation (iPAV) captured extensive transcript diversification during domestication and horticultural differentiation, providing additional resolution beyond locus-level analyses, particularly within loci shared across the population.
